thesaurus.definition: relating to or affecting the viscera
obtained through intuition rather than from reasoning or observation

examples: visceral remains
wiktionary.gloss: Of or relating to, made up of, or positioned among or within, the viscera (“internal organs of the body, especially those contained within the abdominal and thoracic cavities”).
Of a disease: involving the viscera.
Of or relating to the viscera or bowels regarded as the origin of a person's emotions; hence (figuratively), relating to or having deep internal feelings or sensibility.
Having to do with the response of the body as opposed to the intellect, as in the distinction between feeling and thinking.
A lout; a yokel.
Motacilla flava, a small passerine bird in the family Motacillidae
